# Local Assetlib SDK preview

These `0.3.0-preview.1` tarballs were built locally from `sdk-js` for this demo. They include named artwork states, signed catalog pages, and image retention policies. They have not been published to npm or GitHub Releases, and installing them does not deploy the demo.

`SHA256SUMS` records the local package hashes. Both SDK dependencies use `file:vendor/...` paths so installation does not require a sibling SDK checkout. Rebuild the packages and update the hashes and package lock together when changing SDK source.
